# SOL Prep

> AI-powered study assistant for Virginia Standards of Learning (SOL) exams. Diagnoses weak spots, then generates guided notes, flashcards, mnemonics, analogies, and SOL-style practice questions mapped to the real Virginia SOL standards for a student's subject and grade.

SOL Prep is currently in pre-launch. The site at solprep.com is a growing reference of Virginia SOL standards by subject and grade; the study app itself lives at app.solprep.com.

## Subjects covered

- Math (Kindergarten through Algebra II, Geometry, Trigonometry, and electives)
- English (Kindergarten through Grade 12)
- Science (Kindergarten through Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and Earth Science electives)
- History & Social Science (Kindergarten through Virginia/US Government)

## Key pages

- /sol — index of all subjects
- /sol/{subject} — all courses and grade levels within a subject
- /sol/{subject}/{course} — the full list of Virginia SOL standards for one course, and how SOL Prep helps study it
